Laser Dentistry With the Solea® Laser in Clearwater, FL

A Faster, Gentler, Stress‑Free Dental Experience


At our boutique Clearwater dental practice, we’re proud to offer Solea® Laser Dentistry — the most advanced, anesthesia‑free dental technology available today. If you’ve ever wished dental visits could feel easier, quieter, and more comfortable, Solea makes that possible. This CO₂ dental laser allows us to perform many procedures without needles, without drills, and without downtime, giving you a smoother, more relaxed experience from start to finish.

What Is the Solea® Laser?

The Solea laser is an FDA‑approved, all‑tissue dental laser designed to treat both teeth and gums with unmatched precision. Its unique wavelength vaporizes tooth structure and soft tissue with minimal sensation, making it ideal for patients who want:

  • No anesthesia or numbness
  • No drill noise or vibration
  • Shorter appointments
  • Faster healing
  • A more comfortable, anxiety‑free visit

Solea is the gold standard for modern, minimally invasive dentistry — and we’re one of the few practices in the Clearwater/Safety Harbor area offering it.

Benefits of Solea® Laser Dentistry

— Needle‑Free & Drill‑Free

Most patients feel little to no sensation during treatment, eliminating the need for injections and the lingering numbness afterward.


— Faster Healing & Less Inflammation

Because the laser is so precise, it preserves healthy tissue and reduces post‑treatment swelling and discomfort.


— Quiet, Comfortable, Stress‑Free

No high‑pitched drill sounds. No pressure. No vibration. Just a calm, smooth experience.


— Same‑Day Convenience

Solea allows us to complete multiple treatments in one visit — often without needing to numb different areas of the mouth.


— Ideal for Kids & Anxious Patients

Children and adults who fear needles or drills love how gentle and quick Solea treatments feel.

What Can the Solea® Laser Treat?

Solea is incredibly versatile. We use it for:

  • Cavity removal (without shots or drills)
  • Gum contouring & reshaping
  • Frenectomies (tongue‑tie & lip‑tie release)
  • Treatment of gum disease
  • Cold sore & canker sore therapy
  • Tooth sensitivity reduction
  • Soft‑tissue procedures with minimal bleeding

Whether you need restorative care or cosmetic enhancements, Solea helps us deliver beautiful results with maximum comfort.

Why Patients Love Solea® at Clearwater Dentist

We’ve designed our entire patient experience around comfort, warmth, and premium care — and Solea fits perfectly into that philosophy. Our patients consistently tell us how surprised they are by:

  • How quick their appointment feels
  • How comfortable the treatment is
  • How easy it is to return to work, school, or life immediately afterward

Solea helps us elevate your visit so you can feel confident, cared for, and completely at ease.

Is Solea® Right for You?

If you want a dental experience that’s faster, gentler, and more modern, the answer is almost always yes. Solea is safe for adults and children and is one of the best ways to make dentistry feel effortless.

Experience Needle‑Free Dentistry in Clearwater

Ready to try the future of dentistry? Book your Solea Laser appointment today and discover how comfortable dental care can truly feel.

Why Patients Choose Laser Dentistry

  • No scalpels, sutures, or shots
  • Minimally invasive dentistry
  • Gentle treatment every time
  • Excellent for those with dental anxiety
  • Immediate results
  • Alternative to traditional dental treatment

Laser Gingivectomy Treatment

Gingivectomies are often performed when the gum tissue is infected by gum disease or there is an excessive amount of gums that prevent proper cleaning of the teeth. A gingivectomy through laser dentistry in Clearwater, FL reshapes infected or excessive gum tissue from around the teeth by removing it without the need for scalpels or bleeding. The result is a more attractive gum line and a smaller pocket depth, allowing gum tissue to reattach to teeth.

Laser Frenectomy Treatment

A frenectomy is a simple procedure that involves severing thin tissue underneath the tongue or upper lip. This tissue often restricts proper movement of the lip or tongue and can cause functional concerns for some patients. Through laser dentistry, we can make frenectomy treatment much easier and quicker. Our laser light will gently severe this connecting tissue quickly and require no need for scalpels or sutures.

Laser Biopsies

With laser dentistry, we can gently remove suspect tissue from areas of the mouth. Biopsies are important to help identify potential cancerous tissue or any other oral concerns that may develop. Using our laser makes these biopsies quick and virtually painless.

Implant Uncovering

When dental implants have been placed in your jaw, they are sometimes left to heal under the gum tissue. Once the implant has fused to the bone, we can uncover the implant from under the gums using laser dentistry. Using a laser makes the process quicker and minimally invasive, causing less harm to you and surrounding tissues.
